notes.title: New Patch with new Map :0
notes.content:
New space assets and level are done. This is the first part of the open world test the map is in play (not the huge open world map but a piece of it.) More features for hosting and finding matches, networking improvements and a few player options. Hope you guys like the new stuff please be sure to report bugs to the discord and thanks for playing. I look forward to expanding this game with more features every month and bringing open world co-op content soon.

https://discord.gg/U6Yxk2F

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34982549/7e0677618c3bddbd81fb931dba5d6dd2a3d5decf.jpg

notes.title: Summer Patch Time :)
notes.content:
With this new update we are introducing the ability to play on whichever map you want. With or without Ai. Now it can be a match filled with just player kills if you would like. So challenge your friends and look for a new summer map coming soon before the steam summer sale is over. Also working on a few more server options like the ability to set game time and how many Ai will spawn. Also being able to change score limits and difficulty of Ai are in the works. Thank you to everyone for feedback!  Keep it coming so I can keep the updates coming ! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34982549/ec26d597276ca1fda451e92f3cdb89bb9728611a.png
